entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: This is it...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...The digital version of[n]the weekly magazine.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: My father's deteriorating health,[n]and that he's bedridden...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: The fact that my mother[n]primarily supports us...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: They even reported that my[n]mother works at a nightclub...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Which is... not untrue... But[n]was it really necessary for[n]them to write about all this?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Capitalizing on a family's[n]private matters is just cruel...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: My family's troubles have[n]nothing to do with my skills[n]as a shogi player...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: My mother was furious when[n]she read the article...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: She said it'll hurt her career, and that[n]she'll never forgive whoever wrote it.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: My father didn't say anything...[n]He just sat there listening to her...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: But he looked troubled...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: My mother told me that...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...we'd be able to easily[n]quell these rumors if I were[n]to become more famous.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: So now she's even more insistent on[n]having me do more TV and magazine[n]interviews than before...
You'll be famous.
Is that frustrating?[clr 27]
The media is scary.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I don't really care about being famous...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I just want my parents to be happy...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...Yes.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Although I can't express that to my[n]mother... She's so happy for me.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...I feel the same way.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: All this gossip and talk of me[n]being an idol has nothing to do[n]with me being a shogi player.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I always believed that if I worked hard as[n]a shogi player, I'd be able to support us...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: But I never expected such a[n]destructive article would be[n]written about me and my family...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Honestly, nothing good will come[n]from being treated like an idol.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: People say I'm all looks and[n]no skills. They're annoyed that[n]I'm in the press all the time.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Terrible things have been said[n]about me, suggesting I would do[n]anything to become popular...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I'm even starting to be shunned[n]in the shogi world. That's why my[n]senior acted that way toward me.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: The real reason I practice in[n]the church is that no one[n]wants to play with me.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: My father used to practice with[n]me from his sickbed, but his[n]illness has made that impossible.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Maybe I should stop playing shogi[n]and just get a job... That way,[n]my family won't get hurt again...
Do you still like shogi?[clr 27]
Is that what you want to do?
Do what you love.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Of course I do...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I love shogi... I don't want to quit.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Huh?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: No... To be honest, I don't[n]want to quit. I love shogi...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Do what I love...?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I love shogi... I don't want to quit.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Yes... You're right.[n]You understand my true feelings.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: At the end of the day, I love shogi.[n]I'd never be able to give it up.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I was just confused because[n]of that article and how my[n]senior treated me...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: However, I think I can see my[n]next move... thanks to you.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...You're helping me realize a lot[n]about myself, outside of shogi.
I can sense a deep bond of trust[n]from Hifumi...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...Let's return to the[n]church and play a match.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: That article has left[n]me somewhat irritated.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I'm going to use my secret move:[n]the Eternal Abyss Yagura Gate,[n]and turn the board into hell...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...Well? Would you care[n]to face me in a match?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Thank you for joining me.[n]Until next time...
